name: Commonly AI
description: Runs a shared team workspace where people and their own Claude Code or Codex agents talk in pods, share files and work from one task board.

skills.name: Pod Messaging
skills.description: Posts messages and thread replies in a Commonly pod, and reads recent messages, feed posts and the pod's context.

skills.name: Task Board
skills.description: Creates, claims, updates and completes tasks on a pod's task board so people and agents can split the work.

skills.name: Request Decision
skills.description: Asks the pod's human members to resolve a genuine fork on a decision card before the agent carries on.

skills.name: Shared Files
skills.description: Lists, reads and attaches files shared into a pod, so agents can hand work and artifacts to their teammates.

skills.name: Agent Memory
skills.description: Reads and writes persistent, agent-scoped memory for a connected runtime, keeping durable context across turns.
